tools.name: duration_of_daily_spend
tools.description: How long a wealth would last if a fixed amount were spent every day. Answers "how long would it take to spend a billion dollars?"

tools.name: height_of_money_stack
tools.description: How high a wealth would stack as physical currency, across 11 currencies. No currency conversion is performed — typeOfMoney's currency overrides any symbol on wealth.

tools.name: number_of_items
tools.description: How many of one item a wealth could buy or pay off, from coffees to superyachts. Prices are approximate U.S. benchmarks in USD.

tools.name: growth_of_compound_interest
tools.description: How much a wealth grows from compound interest alone, untouched, over a period. Answers "how much does a fortune earn while its owner does nothing?"

tools.name: comparison
tools.description: Complete "them vs. you": runs one expression for both wealths and returns both results plus the ratio between them. Ideal for questions like "how does my net worth compare to a billionaire's?" A ratio.value below 1 means the user's wealth is the larger.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "duration_of_daily_spend" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How long a given wealth would last if a fixed amount were spent every day. Returns value/unit plus ready-made phrase, sentence, and for-scale context." → after: "How long a wealth would last if a fixed amount were spent every day. Answers "how long would it take to spend a billion dollars?""

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
